Name: The Analytical Engine
Review: A film about a machine nobody built, and it is smart enough to know the argument is the subject. Loses its nerve in the middle act looking for a villain; recovers entirely once it gives up and lets two people disagree.

Name: Nine Bridges
Review: Nothing happens for forty minutes and then everything that happens is consequence. I have not stopped thinking about the last shot, which is just a room after everyone has left it.

Name: The Long Wire
Review: Handsome and inert. Every scene states its theme and then a character restates it, and by the third act I was arguing with the script instead of watching it.

Name: Marginalia
Review: Second time through and the structure finally landed: it is a two-pass film, and the first pass is deliberately withholding the map. Better than I gave it credit for, which is an uncomfortable thing to admit in writing.
